# airflow-nomad

> Apache Airflow integration for Nomad-managed jobs

## Pages

- [airflow-nomad](index.html.md): Run and monitor Nomad-managed jobs from Apache Airflow.
- [Tutorial: run your first Nomad job](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): We will run a five-second batch job from Airflow, monitor its completion, and remove its generated jobspec.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): Run Nomad jobs from inline Python or airflow-config YAML. Both formats use the Nomad CLI on the Airflow worker to reach the cluster’s API.
- [How to forward Nomad logs and alert on failures](docs/src/observability.html.md): Enable forwarding on the configuration passed to an existing Nomad task group:

- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): The public integration API is exported from airflow_nomad. Jobspec models and the CLI client are re-exported from nomad_pydantic, whose API reference describ...
